rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of --save-exact without --save or --save-dev in install function
rawFindings.explanation: The condition to apply --save-exact only when --save or --save-dev is present was removed, allowing --save-exact alone to modify the _json object in memory but never actually save the dependencies or devDependencies to bower.json. This results in unexpected behavior where the --save-exact flag alone does not persist versions to bower.json, and users might incorrectly expect dependencies to be saved.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the conditional to require --save or --save-dev for modifying dependencies or devDependencies, or update logic to handle saving dependencies properly when only --save-exact is used.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Running `bower install <package>` with only --save-exact flag (no --save or --save-dev) does not write any dependencies to bower.json, although the versions appear set in memory.
